Container.Name: Argus-Updater
Container.Overview: Optional sidecar for Argus: performs one-click core self-updates on the core's behalf so the public-facing Argus container never needs the Docker socket. Watches a folder shared with Argus; on an admin-triggered update it pulls the newest release, recreates the Argus container cloning its config, verifies health, and rolls back on failure. Runs no web service.

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Docker socket - required so the updater can pull the image and recreate the Argus core container. Host-level access; this container is not web-facing.

Config.Name: Self-update channel
Config.Description: The SAME host folder you mapped as Argus's Self-update channel. The core drops requests here; the updater writes results back.

Config.Name: Core container name
Config.Description: Name of the Argus container to update (must match its container name exactly).

Config.Name: Core image repo
Config.Description: Argus core image repository (used to pull the new version and, if the name is not found, to locate the container).

Config.Name: Poll interval (s)
Config.Description: How often to check the shared folder for a queued update.
